$comment: Where each project subagent may write with Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit. Enforced by agent_write_guard.py. Paths are repository-relative globs ('*' = one path segment, '**' = any depth). 'deny' wins over 'allow'. An empty 'allow' means read-only. Agents not listed here (and the main session) are left to the normal permission flow. Bash is NOT covered; the agent definitions prohibit writing through it. No agent may write the guard itself, this file or .claude/settings.json (ADR 0006, amendment 1).
